# Calendar

**Figma:** Calendar/Toolbar, Week-Strip, Month, Time-Grid, Agenda and .Primitives/Calendar/* (page ❖ Calendar 16121:3)  
**Import:** `import { CalendarToolbar, CalendarMonth, CalendarTimeGrid, CalendarAgenda, CalendarWeekStrip } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Show events over time: a month of days, a week or day of hours, or an agenda list, with the Toolbar that moves the period and switches the view. The views take the events as data (id, title, start, end, allDay, color, meta, attendees) and draw the Figma primitives (Event chips, Event-Blocks, Agenda-Items, Day-Cells).

## Use it for
- A team or personal calendar page: CalendarToolbar over CalendarMonth, CalendarTimeGrid (week / day) or CalendarAgenda.
- On a phone: CalendarMonth device mobile with the picked day's CalendarAgenda under it, or CalendarWeekStrip over a Day CalendarTimeGrid.
- A day planner or side panel: CalendarWeekStrip variant tile over a one-day CalendarAgenda.

## Use something else for
- Picking a date in a form → DatePicker / DateField.
- An activity history (who did what) → a List or Timeline, not CalendarAgenda.
- Resources side by side (people, rooms) → Schedule (not in code yet), not one Time-Grid per person.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Views | `CalendarMonth · CalendarTimeGrid view · CalendarAgenda` | Month · Week / Day (Mobile 3-Day) · Agenda |
| Device | `device` | desktop · mobile; unset follows the breakpoint |
| Color | `events[].color · CalendarEvent color` | brand (default) · blue · violet · teal · green · orange · pink |
| Kind | `events[].allDay · CalendarEvent kind` | timed · all-day |
| State=Selected | `selectedEventId · selected` | the event whose details are open |
| Sixth-Week | `(automatic)` | a month that spans six weeks |
| Style | `CalendarWeekStrip variant` | dot · tile |
| Title | `CalendarToolbar title · date` | the period; default from date and view |

### CalendarMonth
Figma `Calendar/Month` (16126:1093). Desktop: a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped) holding the weekday row (Caption/Medium Neutral/Base, Padding/XSmall, a Pale rule under it) and 5 weeks — 6 when the month spans six (Figma Sixth-Week) — of `.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Cell`, Monday first; days of the next and previous month are Outside. A cell shows its events as `.Primitives/Calendar/Event` chips: all up to three, else two and "+N more". Mobile: single-letter weekdays (Caption/Medium Neutral/Light) over weeks of `.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` (DatePickerItem) with the event dot, Gap/2XSmall between rows; days outside the month are blank. Semantics: an APG grid — desktop: weekday column headers and a row per week of gridcells; each day's date is a button named "Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 3 events" that selects the day (`aria-pressed`; today `aria-current="date"`). One date is in the tab order; the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home / End to the week's ends. Event chips are buttons with `onEventClick`. Mobile days are the date-picker buttons with the same keys.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `month` | `Date \| string` | — | The month to show (any day in it). Default: the selected day's month, else today's. Move it with the Toolbar. |
| `value` | `CalendarDateInput \| null` | — | The selected day (controlled): Day-Cell State=Selected on desktop, Single-Selected on mobile. |
| `defaultValue` | `CalendarDateInput \| null` | `null` | The selected day at first (uncontrolled). Default: none on desktop. |
| `onValueChange` | `(date: Date) => void` | — | Called with the day the person presses. |
| `events` | `CalendarEventData[]` | `[]` | The events to show: chips in the desktop cells, a dot under the mobile days. |
| `onEventClick` | `(event: CalendarEventData, target: HTMLElement) => void` | — | Pressing an event chip (desktop): open its details, anchored to `target`. Without it the chips are static. |
| `selectedEventId` | `string \| null` | `null` | The event whose details are open: its chip shows State=Selected. |
| `onMoreClick` | `(date: Date) => void` | — | Pressing "+N more" (desktop): show the whole day (its Agenda or Day view). Without it "+N more" is text. |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (a 7-column grid of Day-Cells with event chips) or `mobile` (date-picker days with an event dot; list the selected day below with CalendarAgenda). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today ("2026-09-30" or a Date). Default: the device clock. |

| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### CalendarToolbar
Figma `Calendar/Toolbar` (16125:399): the control row above a calendar view. Desktop: Today (Button/Main Small Tertiary), Previous / Next (Button/Icon-Main Small Tertiary, Gap/XSmall), the period in Heading/3 (Gap/Small after the Today button), and the view switch (Segmented Secondary Small) at the end, Gap/Medium. Mobile: the title with Today and the arrows (Medium, 40px, Gap/XSmall) on one row, the full-width switch (Segmented Medium) Gap/Small under it. Only Tertiary buttons: the page's main action (New event) belongs to the page header. The title is an `aria-live` heading, so moving to another period is announced.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

| `view` | `"month" \| "week" \| "day" \| "3-day" \| "agenda"` | `"month"` | The selected view of the switch. |
| `views` | `CalendarView[]` | `["month", "week", "day", "agenda"]` | The views the switch offers, in order (Figma: Month · Week · Day · Agenda). Hide views the product does not offer; an empty list hides the switch. |

### CalendarTimeGrid
Figma `Calendar/Time-Grid` (16127:1172): the week and day views. A Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped) with three rows, each split by a Pale rule: the days (weekday Caption/Medium Neutral/Base over a Large `.Primitives/Calendar/Date`, Padding/XSmall, Gap/3XSmall), the all-day row ("All day" Caption/Regular Neutral/Light; all-day `.Primitives/Calendar/Event` chips, Padding/2XSmall) and the hours: a gutter of hour labels (Caption/Regular Neutral/Light, 56px desktop / 44px mobile) beside day columns of 30-minute `.Primitives/Calendar/Slot` rows (64px per hour, the hour rule on top), each column split by a Pale rule. `.Primitives/Calendar/Event-Block` instances sit at their start time — y = (start − first hour) × 64 + 1, height = length × 64 − 2, 2px from the column's left edge and 4px from its right — and overlapping events share the column in lanes. The `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` crosses today's column at the current minute. Semantics: each day column is a group named with its date; blocks are buttons with `onEventClick` (named by title and time). The header, hour labels, slots and the now line are decorative. Give the box a height (or max-height) to scroll the hours under the fixed day header.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | `"week" \| "day" \| "3-day"` | — | Figma View: `week` (Monday to Sunday), `day`, or `3-day` (the day before, the day, the day after). Default `week` on desktop and `3-day` on mobile; `week` on a phone draws the 3-Day grid (a week does not fit). |
| `date` | `Date \| string` | — | The day the view is built around ("2026-09-30" or a Date). Default: today. |
| `events` | `CalendarEventData[]` | `[]` | The events: all-day ones in the all-day row, timed ones as blocks at their hours. |
| `startHour` | `number` | `8` | First hour shown (default 8: 08:00). |
| `endHour` | `number` | `18` | Hour the grid ends at (default 18: the last row is 17:00–18:00). Extend it for longer days. |
| `now` | `Date \| string` | — | The current time: the now line in today's column. Default: the device clock, updated every minute. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today (the Accent date, the now line). Default: `now`'s day. |
| `onEventClick` | `(event: CalendarEventData, target: HTMLElement) => void` | — | Pressing an event: open its details, anchored to `target`. Without it the blocks are static. |
| `selectedEventId` | `string \| null` | `null` | The event whose details are open: its block (or chip) shows State=Selected. |
| `onSlotPress` | `(start: Date) => void` | — | Pressing an empty slot (pointer): the start of that half hour, to create an event there. Keyboard users create events from the page's main action. |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (56px hour gutter) or `mobile` (44px). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the grid (default: the period, "Sep 28 – Oct 4, 2026"). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the blocks and dates it draws (`{ "Day[2]/Date": { size: "md" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### CalendarAgenda
Figma `Calendar/Agenda` (16128:1036): days in order, each with its events as `.Primitives/Calendar/Agenda-Item` rows. Desktop: a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base) of day rows (Padding Medium · Large, Gap/Large) split by Pale rules: a 48px date column (weekday in All-Caps/S, Large date; Today in Accent) beside the rows (Gap/2XSmall). Mobile: per day a Body/Small/Bold kicker ("Today · Wed, Sep 30" in Accent/Base, other days Neutral/Light), Gap/XSmall to its rows (Gap/3XSmall), Gap/Large between days. Empty days are left out; a range without events shows an Empty-State.

### CalendarWeekStrip
Figma `Calendar/Week-Strip` (16125:520): one week of selectable days. Dot: seven columns spread across the width, each a weekday (Caption/Medium, Neutral/Light) over a `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Item` (desktop 32) or `.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` (mobile 40) — DatePickerItem — Gap/2XSmall apart, with the event dot; the selected day is State=Single-Selected, today State=Today. Tile: seven `.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Tile` sharing the width, Gap/2XSmall. Days are buttons named with their full date (`aria-pressed` on the selected one, `aria-current="date"` on today); the arrow keys move between them. Not to pick a date in a form: use DatePicker.

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type CalendarColor = "brand" | "blue" | "violet" | "teal" | "green" | "orange" | "pink"
type CalendarDateInput = Date | string
interface CalendarEventData { id: string; title: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end?: CalendarDateInput; allDay?: boolean; color?: CalendarColor; meta?: string; attendees?: Array<{ src?: string; alt?: string }>; }
type CalendarView = "month" | "week" | "day" | "3-day" | "agenda"
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the Toolbar's buttons, the view switch, the month's one focusable date and the events |
| ← / → | Month and week strip: the previous / next day |
| ↑ / ↓ | Month: the same day a week before / after |
| Home / End | Month and week strip: the first / last day of the week |
| Enter / Space | Select the focused day; open the focused event |

## ✅ Do
- Put CalendarToolbar above the view and move the period with shiftPeriod(date, view, ±1); Today returns to today's period.
- Give every calendar a colour and keep it: Brand for the main calendar, the other hues only to tell calendars apart.
- Pass `today` (and `now` for the Time-Grid) when your app's date is not the device clock, so Today and the now line agree with your data.
- Open an event's details from onEventClick and set selectedEventId while they are open (State=Selected).
- Give the Time-Grid a height (or max-height) so the hours scroll under the fixed day header.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't put the page's main action (New event) in the Toolbar: it belongs to the page header; the Toolbar has only Tertiary buttons.
- Don't use buttons for the view switch: the Toolbar's switch is a Segmented.
- Don't put filters (which calendars) in the Toolbar: they are Chip advanced in the page's Control-Bar.
- Don't colour events with Accent: Today and the now line are the only Accent on a grid.
- Don't draw a week CalendarTimeGrid on a phone: it shows the 3-Day grid there.

## Accessibility
- The Toolbar title is a heading with aria-live, so Previous, Next and Today announce the new period; the arrows are named "Previous month" / "Next week" by the view.
- The month is an APG grid (weekday column headers, a row per week): each date is a button named with its full date and event count ("Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 3 events"), aria-pressed on the selected day and aria-current="date" on today.
- One date of the month (and of the week strip) is in the tab order; the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home / End to the week's ends.
- Time-Grid day columns are groups named with their date; event blocks are buttons with onEventClick, named by title and time. Hours, slots and the now line are decorative.
- Pressing an empty slot (onSlotPress) is pointer-only: offer New event in the page header for keyboard users.

## Content
- Event titles are short and specific ("Q4 planning", "1:1 Maya Chen"); the place or link goes in meta.
- Times are 24-hour in the locale (09:00); all-day events say "All day".

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `calendar/toolbar-navigation` | warn | A CalendarToolbar moves the period and switches the view: without onPrevious / onNext its arrows are disabled, and while its view switch is shown (views not empty) it needs onViewChange, or pressing a view does nothing. | `zen-allow-calendar-navigation: <reason>` |
| `calendar/week-on-phone` | warn | A week does not fit a phone: CalendarTimeGrid device="mobile" draws view="week" as the 3-Day grid (Figma Time-Grid Mobile has 3-Day and Day). Write view="3-day" so the code says what the screen shows. | `zen-allow-calendar-week-phone: <reason>` |
| `calendar/selected-needs-handler` | warn | selectedEventId marks the event whose details are open (Figma State=Selected); without onEventClick the events are not buttons, so nothing opens or closes the details and the selection never changes. | `zen-allow-calendar-selected: <reason>` |
